items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I used to hear Charley Johnson's Orchestra, from Small's Paradise. Which also I was very impressed with.

ctx.x: Well, at that particular age, if we're going to go back as far as that, seven or eight years old, that would be pretty hard to say. I used to hear broadcasts from the nightclubs, and of course they were -- the quality was ridiculous. But I remember hearing a saxophone player at the time, Ross Gorman, and he had an orchestra and he played at a club, I believe it was called the Monte Carlo Club. That was

back in the '20s, then I used to hear Charley Johnson's Orchestra, from Small's Paradise. Which also I was very impressed with. But they used to come on rather late, and I had to kind of sneak, you know, listening to them, because I was supposed to be in bed and asleep.
That was when you were probably how old, that you were listening to the nightclub shows?
